call_points.text: New generation product revenues grew at 35.8% QoQ and 36.7% YoY.
Management will hold FY27 guidance until more clarity on margin recovery is available in Q2.
Heltar acquisition is a capability buy, not a large-scale business acquisition, funded by internal accruals.
New product portfolio (RCS, WhatsApp) is growing at 14% YoY, significantly ahead of the company average.
The Colombian security incident investigation is ongoing; management expects minimal additional costs beyond the Q1 provision.
Management guided for mid-to-high single-digit revenue growth and ~12% EBITDA margin for FY27.
call_points.versus_prior: new formal guidance provided for FY27

call_points.text: Regular dividend increased by 50% from ₹11 per share to a sustainable ₹16.5 per share.
Organic capex remains flat and insignificant, with focus on internal platform development and targeted M&A for AI capabilities.

FY27 guidance to be held until more clarity is available in Q2

industry: Telecommunication > Telecom - Services > Other Telecom Services

operating_notes.text: Gross Dividend per share increased to a sustainable ₹16.5 for FY26.
New products revenue in FY26 reached ₹3,526 mn (~₹352.6 Cr), growing at a 4-year CAGR of 43% from FY22 to FY26.
ILD A2P SMS represents approximately one-fourth to one-third of total revenue.
Net revenue retention stands at 98% for the year, with slight impact from one key customer.
Cash conversion for Q1 was weak due to delayed collections from large clients in India and UAE, but expected to revert to 75-100% for the full year.
Heltar Technologies acquisition completed in July 2026 for ₹33.7 crore on a slump sale basis.

timeline.summary: Route Mobile announced that CGIT stayed EPFO recovery orders of ₹28.16 lakh against subsidiary Send Clean Private Limited subject to deposits.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,130.9 Cr (-3.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹109.32 Cr (+93.2% YoY).
Route Mobile announced Q4FY26 and FY26 financial results with revenue of ₹4,408.21 crore and PAT of ₹256.94 crore.
Route Mobile reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,130.9 Cr, down 3.8% YoY, while Adj. PAT rose 34.6% YoY to ₹114.4 Cr.
Route Mobile filed its Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, showing ₹65 Cr unutilized IPO proceeds.
Devendra Tejas Shah informed BSE and NSE of the May 08, 2026 earnings call recording on strategy and audited FY/Q4 2025-26 results, available at routemobile.com.
Route Mobile hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 15, 2026, guiding for mid-to-high single-digit revenue growth and a ~12% EBITDA margin in FY27.
Route Mobile reported Q1FY27 results with 10% YoY revenue growth, announced the acquisition of Heltar Technologies, and discussed margin pressures and strategic initiatives on its earnings call.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,179.67 Cr (+5.4% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹79.57 Cr (against a loss of ₹21.21 Cr a year earlier).
Route Mobile reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹1,179.67 Cr (+5.4% YoY) and adjusted EBITDA of ₹118.4 Cr, and detailed the Heltar acquisition integration.
Route Mobile reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹1,179.67 Cr and PAT of ₹82.55 Cr.
